Oct 11

Progress note Oct 11 (synthetic QA).
74-year-old man with CKD stage 3 and heart failure
with reduced ejection fraction, admitted Oct 9
for volume overload.
Vitals: BP 142/88, HR 96, temp 38.4 C, SpO2 93% on 2 L.
Labs: creatinine 1.1, potassium 4.2, BNP 1250.
Chest X-ray Oct 9: bilateral pleural effusions.
TTE Oct 10: EF 30%.
Assessment and plan:
1) Acute on chronic HFrEF, continue IV furosemide.
2) CKD stage 3, trend creatinine daily.
3) Renal ultrasound pending.
